description:
Executable Candidate native TP2 recipe for vcruz305's MiniMax-M3.1-Flash EXL3 SAGE 2.15 bpw pack (428B total, 23B active mixture of experts, 119 GB, language model only, DSpark draft in the pack) on two Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 2 over the native multi-node executor, from tonyd2wild's MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-EXL3-TP2-2x-DGX-Spark kit at 70c4e433. No prebuilt image exists, so the recipe's Dockerfile builds what the kit serves from the same pins: the vLLM image vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash by digest, vcruz305's exllamav3 fork (feat/moe-act3-batched, fdd77361) and vllm-exl3 plugin (feat/minimax-q4-prefill, 41fdb7d9), the plugin carrying the kit's two TP>1 patches (fused QKV and indexer rows per rank, LM head), all compiled for sm_121 with a build-time scan that the compiled extensions carry loadable code. The launch is the kit's m31_tp2.sh: 300,000-token context, 6 sequences, 4,096 batched tokens, q4 (nvfp4) main KV in a 20,000,000,000-byte pool per rank with fp8 indexer and draft KV, gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 (the startup free-memory check beside the pinned pool), DSpark k = 3, FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs at sizes 1-24, FlashInfer autotune off, the minimax_m3 reasoning and tool parsers, and the kit's VLLM_EXL3 and allocator environment. Creator figures (39 tok/s single stream on counting, about 20 tok/s on prose, 46.5 tok/s aggregate with four mixed streams, 500-570 tok/s cold prefill, 350 s boot, about 30 GiB free per node at ready) are upstream claims until measured here. The pack is Hugging Face gated by the creator's account notes and needs a provider token. The 4.26 bpw pack does not fit two Sparks per the kit and is not packaged. License: MiniMax Community License (free for non-commercial use; commercial use has attribution and notice conditions; prohibited-use appendix), shown as information only; the plugin patches are AGPL-3.0-only like the plugin.
 The declared per-node peak is 0.85 x 130,663,231,488 bytes (111,063,746,765), the free memory vLLM requires at startup beside the pinned pool; the creator measured about 30 GiB free per node at ready (roughly 93 GB of workload use), so this is the admission envelope, an estimate until the hardware try measures it.
title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash EXL3 SAGE 2.15bpw vLLM DSpark two Sparks
